items.question: Why does DeepWalk handle weighted networks better than the proposed model when the edges have real-valued strengths rather than binary links?
items.false_premise: DeepWalk handles weighted networks better than the proposed model.
items.correction: DeepWalk only applies to unweighted networks, while the proposed model is applicable to networks with both weighted and unweighted edges.
items.evidence_quote: Practically, DeepWalk only applies to unweighted networks, while our model is applicable for networks with both weighted and unweighted edges.
